overview: The Market Terraces are Shar Vahl’s primary commercial hub, connecting clan trade, artisan goods, and caravan commerce.
history: The terraces were carved to create layered merchant platforms.
Clan traders established permanent stalls along the upper terraces.
Caravan posts were added to support inter-regional trade.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the terraces were expanded with new vendor alcoves.
Royal Guard patrols began monitoring the terraces for trade disputes.
hooks: A caravan arrives with rare goods from Hollowshade Moor.
A merchant stall experiences a hazardous flare.
A clan trader disputes pricing with a caravan broker.
A supply runner reports missing goods.
